# Bulk SiO2 calculation

units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p p

read_data alpha_quartz.data

pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /potentials/TERSOFF/2007_SiO.tersoff Si O

replicate 5 5 5

minimize ${etol} ${ftol} ${maxiter} ${maxeval}

variable E equal pe
variable V equal vol
variable Eb equal $E
variable Vb equal $V

print "Bulk_energy = ${Eb}"
print "Bulk_volume = ${Vb}"

# Surface SiO2 calculation

units metal
atom_style full
boundary p p s  # non-periodic in z direction for surface

read_data alpha_quartz.data

pair_style tersoff
pair_coeff * * /potentials/TERSOFF/2007_SiO.tersoff Si O

replicate 5 5 5

minimize ${etol} ${ftol} ${maxiter} ${maxeval}

variable E equal pe
variable A equal lx*ly  # surface area
variable Es equal $E
variable As equal $A

print "Surface_energy = ${Es}"
print "Surface_area = ${As}"

# Main script to calculate surface energy

# Set minimization parameters
variable etol equal 1.0e-10
variable ftol equal 1.0e-10
variable maxiter equal 100000
variable maxeval equal 100000

# Run bulk calculation
include bulk.in

# Store bulk results
variable bulk_E equal ${Eb}
variable bulk_V equal ${Vb}

# Run surface calculation
include surface.in

# Calculate surface energy
variable surf_E equal ${Es}
variable surf_A equal ${As}

# Surface energy = (E_surface - E_bulk)/(2*A)
# Factor of 2 because we create two surfaces
variable gamma equal (${surf_E}-${bulk_E})/(2.0*${surf_A})

print "Surface_energy_eV_per_A2 = ${gamma}"
